title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful and juicy lamb wrap inspired by the cuisine of Saudi Arabia, filled with tender lamb and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Unique spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available in most Middle Eastern markets

ingredients.name: Dense flatbread
ingredients.notes: Found in most Arabic or Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Season the lamb with salt, black pepper, and unique spice blend.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the lamb to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the flatbread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of lamb down the center of each wrap, followed by chopped onion, cucumber, tomato, lettuce, and parsley.
